name: ai.founden/founden
title: Founden
description: Sketch a company in your AI assistant, then open it in Founden to build and run it.

tools.name: sketch_company
tools.description: Shows the first shape of a company someone wants to start: its name, what it sells and to whom, and its first pages, with whether the name's .com, .co, .ai and .app domains are available, and a link that opens the company in Founden, which builds its website, product and back office and runs them. For when a person describes a business, product or service they want to start. Its inputs are the person's idea and the name, offer, audience and pages written from it; called again with changed inputs, it shows the changed sketch. It creates no account and stores nothing.

idea.description: What the person said they want to start, in their own words.

name.description: The company's name: short and brandable, a name it could put on its website.

offer.description: What it sells, in one sentence: the product or service and what the buyer gets.

audience.description: Who buys it, in a few words.

pages.description: Its first pages, the home page first: each a title and what the page says or lets a visitor do.

title.description: The page's title, as its menu would name it.

purpose.description: What the page says or lets a visitor do, in one sentence.
